overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for long-running campaigns and optimizing the Monte Carlo convergence logic for ultra-endgame scenarios. This batch ensures memory stability and logical consistency after 5,500+ ticks.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array for fixed-size buffers. Implement a static lookup table for common state transitions. Avoid std::vector. Use constexpr for table generation. Ensure all functions are noexcept where possible. Max 60 lines of logic.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Compresses 5,500 tick states into <1KB. 2. Decompression is bit-exact. 3. No dynamic allocations in hot path.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster load times and stable memory usage for long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence for Ultra-Endgame
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement early-exit conditions for Monte Carlo simulations when variance < 1e-6. Use fixed-point arithmetic for intermediate steps to avoid FP drift. Keep logic self-contained within the struct.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Simulation completes in <10ms for 5,500 ticks. 2. Variance check triggers correctly. 3. No cascading header dependencies.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother frame rates during complex endgame calculations.
